proof_summary.N_of_f: N(f)=max(2,m_f+1). This is the least cofinal level at which the new d_n, the new column n+2 and the square-to-split frontier columns n,n+1 are outside cl(f).
proof_summary.active_root_partition: Fix f and n>=N(f). A fine root is active only if it changes a retained ell coordinate in f or a selected closed-face holonomy. Every active root has support in cl(f); all fine roots outside cl(f), including all new-column, d_n and frontier roots, have zero lifted observable increment.
proof_summary.common_cylinder: A_cyl^gr is the algebraic union of bounded functions of finitely many retained integer occupations ell_v and finitely many closed-face holonomy characters, invariant under the declared gauge action and anchor-preserving automorphisms. It cannot inspect the disjoint-union grade, aperture, open links or phases. R-488 ell_a, ell_d, H_0 and H_1 are included.
proof_summary.generator_sum_identity: Split both finite root sums into active matched roots and zero-increment roots. The matched summands are equal by the preceding two identities and the zero class contributes zero. Therefore (L_(n+1) I_(n,n+1) f)(x)=(I_(n,n+1) L_n f)(x) for every x, every R>=1 and every n>=N(f).
proof_summary.local_rate_identity: Because the displayed PAH functional is a sum of onsite, edge and face terms and the affected term list is identical, DeltaF_fine(r,x)=DeltaF_coarse(r_bar,p(x)). The mobility rule reads the same retained endpoint/aperture coordinates, hence c_fine(r,x)=c_coarse(r_bar,p(x)) for every R>=1.
proof_summary.projection: For x=(Q_f,omega_f), use p_(n+1,n)(x)=(Q_c,omega_f restricted to G_n), where Q_c is the sum of retained ell coordinates. The balance Q_f-Q_c is the nonnegative sum of the two dropped-column occupations. No coordinate is reassigned.
proof_summary.root_correspondence: For every active fine root r, there is one and only one old root r_bar with the same family, geometric label, direction or Z_2 channel, admissibility, changed retained coordinates, endpoint mobility and affected PAH energy-term list. The map is bijective on active roots.
